acceptance.status_reason: REPORTED FAIL DELIBERATELY, AND IT IS A PREMISE DEFECT, NOT A WORK FAILURE. The criterion is a CONJUNCTION and its third clause asserts a fact that measurement falsifies: /session/token is NOT distinct from the datamining mint on the 49F principal (byte-identical, sha256[:16]=e3c20170eedbafd3). A conjunction containing a false clause is false, so PASS would be an overclaim and would silently retire a falsified premise as though it had been proven. Clauses 1 and 2 are fully satisfied and the leg is built AND exercised.
